summary: Practise SAR planning, ICS coordination, POA/POD analysis, and QGIS mapping. Explore the five-day course outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: Search and rescue training helps team leaders, coordinators, and planners create defensible plans for changing field conditions. Participants practise prioritizing search areas with POA and POD reasoning, creating QGIS maps, and organizing assignments and handovers using ICS and IAMSAR coordination concepts. They also develop safety controls and ways to track clues and document operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for people who plan, coordinate, or conduct search and rescue operations and need to make defensible decisions under changing field conditions.
audience: Urban search and rescue team supervisors
prerequisites: Prior practical experience or training in search and rescue, emergency response, or incident coordination is recommended. No programming experience is required. Bring a laptop for the QGIS mapping exercise; no specific software pre-installation is assumed.
